title: Weak Order on the MacNeille Completion of Bruhat Order
summary: Let $\mathrm{Mac}(W)$ be the MacNeille completion of the Bruhat order of a Coxeter group $W$. We introduce an action of the $0$-Hecke monoid of type $W$ on $\mathrm{Mac}(W)$, which allows us to define a weak order and a descent set statistic on $\mathrm{Mac}(W)$. When $W$ is of type $A$, we recover constructions of Hamaker and Reiner, which were originally formulated in terms of monotone triangles and alternating sign matrices.
